title: RubricEM: Meta-RL with Rubric-guided Policy Decomposition beyond Verifiable Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2605.10899v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep research agents plan, search, evaluate evidence, and synthesize long-form reports. Training these agents with reinforcement learning (RL) is challenging because they operate over long horizons and their outputs lack exact answer verifiers. To this end, we introduce RubricEM, a unified RL framework for deep research that combines stagewise credit assignment with reflection-based meta-RL for experience reuse. Rubrics unify the framework by providing a shared interface for policy execution, judge feedback, and experience reuse. RubricEM first instills a rubric-guided scaffold through supervised fine-tuning, teaching the agent to plan with rubrics and organize its trajectory into semantic stages. Building on this structural prior, we optimize the task policy with Stage-Structured GRPO, using stagewise judge feedback for finer-grained credit assignment. translated_title: RubricEM：超越可验证奖励的量规引导策略分解元强化学习
translated_abstract: 深度研究智能体需要进行规划、搜索、评估证据并合成长篇报告。使用强化学习（RL）训练这类智能体极具挑战性，因为它们需要在长时域上运行，且其输出缺乏精确的答案验证器。为此，我们提出了RubricEM，一个面向深度研究的统一强化学习框架，它将分阶段信用分配与基于反思的元强化学习（用于经验复用）相结合。量规通过为策略执行、裁判反馈和经验复用提供共享接口，统一了整个框架。RubricEM首先通过监督微调灌输量规引导的脚手架，教会智能体使用量规进行规划，并将其轨迹组织为语义阶段。在此结构先验的基础上，我们使用阶段结构化GRPO优化任务策略，利用分阶段的裁判反馈实现更细粒度的信用分配。与此同时，我们异步训练一个具有共享主干的反思元策略（wi……
tldr: RubricEM提出一个统一的强化学习框架，通过量规引导的阶段结构化策略分解实现细粒度信用分配，并结合基于反思的元强化学习实现经验复用，解决了深度研究智能体在长时域任务且缺乏精确答案验证器时的训练难题。
en_tdlr: RubricEM is a unified RL framework for deep research agents that combines rubric-guided stagewise credit assignment (Stage-Structured GRPO) with reflection-based meta-RL for experience reuse, tackling the challenge of training over long horizons where outputs lack exact answer verifiers.
